title: Call: Channel 6 News Director — "One Message, Ten Minutes"

transcript.speaker: CH6 NEWS DIR
transcript.text: Brennan EOC, this is Andrea Lusk, News Director at Channel 6. Is this the PIO? Good. I've got ten minutes, so I'm going fast.

transcript.speaker: CH6 NEWS DIR
transcript.text: We hit the 00:30 block from the basement in ten minutes. One camera, laptop radar, that's it. The Chief needs ONE county message we can read word for word. Three things. Where do people go now that they've lost their homes. What do they do about damage reports. And the roads. Give it to me the way the county says it, and we'll say the county said it.

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: Understood. Stand by.

transcript.speaker: CH6 NEWS DIR
transcript.text: Second thing. Master control's log shows our 23:01 cut-in said we were, quote, checking reports of a locked shelter in Corwin. Whatever the truth is, we owe viewers a correction, and I want it in this block. Is the Corwin Community Center open or not? Since when? Is Ashford Middle open?

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: Let me confirm that with the floor.

transcript.speaker: CH6 NEWS DIR
transcript.text: Third. River Valley News 12 just went live saying, quote, at least six dead at the candle plant, according to a firefighter on scene. My anchor wants to match it. Do you have a number? Can you confirm it or knock it down? If I don't hear from you, he's going to say it.

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: Hold on that.

transcript.speaker: CH6 NEWS DIR
transcript.text: And you should know, BrennanAlert isn't reaching anybody in Corwin. Phones up there are dead. Anyone with a battery radio or a car radio picking up our audio, we're the only channel you've got up north right now. Who's my county contact for the facts after this, you or the Warning Officer?

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: Give me a second.

transcript.speaker: CH6 NEWS DIR
transcript.text: Ten minutes. Email it to the newsroom or read it to me now and I'll type. Go.
